units.source_text: “我就这样，等醒醒酒就走，得趁天亮以前赶回去。”

en.t: I will just stay like this, and once I sober up a little I will go. I have to get back before dawn.

units.source_text: 女子膝行过去拉住岛村：“不要管我，叫你睡嘛。”

en.t: The woman crawled over on her knees and caught hold of Shimamura. Do not worry about me, I told you to sleep.
